Post Text:
Looking for a Dropshipping / Optical Supply Partner ? Eyewear & Sunglasses
I?m looking to connect with reliable suppliers or manufacturers who can support a dropshipping business specialising in prescription glasses, fashion eyewear and sunglasses.

Ideally, I?m looking for someone with direct experience in the optical industry, preferably manufacturers or established wholesalers rather than trading agents or multiple layers of intermediaries.

I?m particularly interested in suppliers who can offer:

* Low MOQ: Ideally order-by-order fulfilment without needing to hold large amounts of stock.

* Private Labelling / Branding: Products shipped directly to customers with our own company branding, including branded packaging, cases, cleaning cloths and other accessories.

* Direct Shipping: Ability to fulfil individual customer orders and ship directly to the end customer.

* Shipping Options: Reliable international shipping, preferably with tracking, reasonable delivery times and competitive shipping costs.

* Product Range: Prescription frames, optical glasses, sunglasses, blue-light glasses and different frame styles/materials.

* Prescription Lens Support: Ability to manufacture lenses based on customer prescriptions, including single vision, progressive, anti-reflective, photochromic and other lens options.

* Quality Control: Consistent product quality, proper lens specifications and quality checks before dispatch.

* Order Integration: Ideally, support for Shopify or other e-commerce platforms through an app, API, CSV or automated order processing.

* Returns & Warranty: Clear policies for defective products, incorrect prescriptions, replacements and customer returns.

I?m looking to establish a long-term business relationship with a supplier who can scale with us as the business grows.

If you?re a manufacturer, direct optical supplier or have experience in eyewear dropshipping, I?d love to have a chat.

Please comment below or send me a private message with:

1. Your company details and location.

2. Product catalogue or website.

3. MOQ and pricing structure.

4. Private-label and branding capabilities.

5. Shipping options and average delivery times.

6. Whether you manufacture prescription lenses in-house or outsource them.

Genuine suppliers and manufacturers preferred. Please no recruitment offers or unnecessary intermediaries.

Thanks!
